shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && printf '\\n--- files ---\\n' && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'src/**' -g '*.{ts,tsx,css,html}' | sed -n '1,120p'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,180p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; printf '\\n--- package ---\\n'; cat package.json; printf '\\n--- main ---\\n'; cat src/main.tsx; printf '\\n--- app ---\\n'; cat src/App.tsx; printf '\\n--- uikit docs ---\\n'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null || true; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit 2>/dev/null | head"
/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | sed -n '1,50p'; printf '\\n--- pc absent/install ---\\n'; npm install @gravity-ui/page-constructor"

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"console.log(require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/package.json').version); console.log(require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/package.json').peerDependencies)\"; ls -d node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/{dist,build} 2>/dev/null; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor -maxdepth 3 -iname 'INDEX.md' -o -iname 'README.md' | head -20"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs/INDEX.md; printf '\\n--- styles/setup exports ---\\n'; node -e \"const p=require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/package.json'); console.log(p.exports)\""

/bin/bash -lc "ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs/blocks | sed -n '1,100p'; printf '\\n--- hero ---\\n'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs/blocks/Hero.md; printf '\\n--- header ---\\n'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs/blocks/Header.md; printf '\\n--- cards candidates ---\\n'; rg -n \"type: '(feature|features|cards|advantage)|Features|Cards\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs/blocks | head -80; printf '\\n--- CTA candidates ---\\n'; rg -n \"CTA|cta|Promo|Banner\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs/blocks | head -80"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs/blocks/Header.md; printf '\\n--- extended ---\\n'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs/blocks/ExtendedFeatures.md; printf '\\n--- banner ---\\n'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs/blocks/Banner.md; printf '\\n--- setup vite ---\\n'; rg -n -C 5 'dynamic-import|sass|scss' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/README.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs/INDEX.md .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs/blocks/ExtendedFeatures.md && printf '\\n---banner---\\n' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs/blocks/Banner.md && printf '\\n---require version---\\n' && sed -n '500,530p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/README.md && cat vite.config.ts && printf '\\n---PC provider API---\\n'; rg -n \"PageConstructorProvider\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/context -g '*.d.ts' | head; rg -n \"export .*PageConstructorProvider\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm -g '*.d.ts' | head"

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"const p=require('./package.json'); console.log(p.dependencies, p.devDependencies)\"; sed -n '1,60p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/Provider.d.ts; sed -n '1,80p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/Constructor.d.ts 2>/dev/null; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/containers/PageConstructor -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%f\\n' | head"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install -D vite-plugin-dynamic-import sass'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,80p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/PageConstructor.d.ts; rg -n \"export type Content|declare.*Content\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm -g '*.d.ts' | head -20"
/bin/bash -lc 'command -v apply_patch || find / -type f -name apply_patch 2>/dev/null | head -20; git status --short'

/bin/bash -lc "cat > /tmp/landing.patch <<'PATCH' diff --git a/vite.config.ts b/vite.config.ts index 59a1408..302f406 100644 --- a/vite.config.ts +++ b/vite.config.ts @@ -1,6 +1,8 @@ import { defineConfig } from 'vite'; Достаточно приглашения команды по email.', + button: { + text: 'Начать пробный период', + url: '#', + }, + width: 's', + }, + ], +}; diff --git a/src/App.tsx b/src/App.tsx index da32237..b76bd1c 100644 --- a/src/App.tsx +++ b/src/App.tsx @@ -1 +1,9 @@ +import { PageConstructor, PageConstructorProvider } from '@gravity-ui/page-constructor'; + +import { landingContent } from './landingContent'; + export function App() { - return

; + return ( + + + + ); } *** End Patch PATCH git apply --verbose /tmp/landing.patch"
/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba /tmp/landing.patch | sed -n '1,80p'; git diff -- vite.config.ts src"
/bin/bash -lc "cat -n vite.config.ts; sed -n '1,20p' src/main.tsx; cat -n src/App.tsx"
/bin/bash -lc 'patch -p1 < /tmp/staged-landing.patch && npm run build && git diff --stat && git diff -- src/App.tsx src/landing.css src/landingContent.tsx src/main.tsx vite.config.ts'
/bin/bash -lc 'cat vite.config.ts'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"url|Vite\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/README.md | tail -40; rg -n \"'url'|from 'url'|require\\('url'\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm -g '*.js' | head; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/utils/url.js"

/bin/bash -lc "find node_modules/url -maxdepth 2 -type f -print 2>/dev/null | head; find node_modules -path '*/url.js' | rg -v '@adiwajshing|chatgpt' | head -20; rg -n '\"dependencies\"' node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/package.json -A15"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install url'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build'

/bin/bash -lc "git diff --check && printf '\\n--- source ---\\n'; sed -n '1,120p' src/App.tsx; sed -n '1,120p' src/landingContent.tsx; sed -n '1,80p' vite.config.ts; sed -n '1,45p' src/main.tsx; printf '\\n--- status ---\\n'; git status --short"
